name: China Publishing & Media Holdings Co., Ltd.
summary: China Publishing & Media Holdings Co., Ltd. publishes books, papers, and periodicals in China. The company offers various publications, including multiple sub-fields including reference books, literature, languages, academic works, politics, ancient texts, law, economics and management, music, fine arts, science and technology, lifestyle, children's books, textbooks and supplementary materials, biographies, and animation. It is also involved in the distribution of books; supply of paper, pulp, and binding materials; and printing and binding publications and other printed materials. The company was founded in 2011 and is based in Beijing, China.
